title: "Progress"
---

<script src="../styles/progress-tracking.js"></script>
<script>
// Load and render progress page on page load
window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  renderProgressPage();
});

function renderProgressPage() {
  // Overall progress section
  renderOverallProgress();
  
  // By topic section
  renderByTopic();
  
  // Quiz history
  renderQuizHistory();
  
  // Areas to revisit
  renderAreasToRevisit();
}

function renderOverallProgress() {
  const progress = loadProgress();
  const accuracy = getQuizAccuracyByTopic();
  const completion = getQuizCompletionByTopic();
  
  const totalAttempts = progress.quiz_attempts.length;
  const totalAccuracy = totalAttempts > 0
    ? Math.round(
        progress.quiz_attempts.reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.score, 0) /
        progress.quiz_attempts.reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.total, 0) *
        100
      )
    : 0;
  
  let html = '<div class="overall-stats">';
  html += `<p><strong>Pages explored:</strong> ${progress.pages_visited.length}</p>`;
  html += `<p><strong>Quizzes completed:</strong> ${totalAttempts}</p>`;
  html += `<p><strong>Average quiz accuracy:</strong> ${totalAccuracy}%</p>`;
  html += `<p><strong>Topics with quizzes:</strong> ${Object.keys(completion).length}</p>`;
  html += `<p><strong>Last active:</strong> ${progress.last_active ? formatRelativeTime(progress.last_active) : "Never"}</p>`;
  html += '</div>';
  
  document.getElementById("overall-progress").innerHTML = html;
}

function renderByTopic() {
  const byTopic = getQuizAttemptsByTopic();
  const accuracy = getQuizAccuracyByTopic();
  
  let html = '<div class="by-topic">';
  
  if (Object.keys(byTopic).length === 0) {
    html += '<p class="placeholder">*Complete a quiz to see progress by topic.*</p>';
  } else {
    html += '<div class="topic-grid">';
    Object.keys(byTopic).sort().forEach(topic => {
      const attempts = byTopic[topic];
      const acc = accuracy[topic];
      const lastAttempt = attempts[attempts.length - 1].date;
      const daysSince = Math.floor((new Date() - new Date(lastAttempt)) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
      
      html += `
        <div class="topic-card">
          <h4>${topic}</h4>
          <p class="topic-stat"><strong>Quizzes:</strong> ${attempts.length}</p>
          <p class="topic-stat"><strong>Accuracy:</strong> ${acc}%</p>
          <p class="topic-stat"><strong>Last attempted:</strong> ${daysSince} days ago</p>
        </div>
      `;
    });
    html += '</div>';
  }
  
  html += '</div>';
  document.getElementById("by-topic").innerHTML = html;
}

function renderQuizHistory() {
  const progress = loadProgress();
  
  if (progress.quiz_attempts.length === 0) {
    document.getElementById("quiz-history").innerHTML = '<p class="placeholder">*No quiz attempts yet.*</p>';
    return;
  }
  
  let html = '<table class="quiz-history-table">';
  html += '<thead><tr><th>Quiz</th><th>Date</th><th>Difficulty</th><th>Score</th><th>Improvement</th></tr></thead>';
  html += '<tbody>';
  
  // Sort by date descending (most recent first)
  const sorted = [...progress.quiz_attempts].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.date) - new Date(a.date));
  
  sorted.forEach((attempt, index) => {
    const dateObj = new Date(attempt.date);
    const dateStr = dateObj.toLocaleDateString("en-AU", { year: "numeric", month: "short", day: "numeric" });
    
    // Check if there's a previous attempt
    const previousAttempts = sorted.slice(index + 1).filter(a => a.quiz_id === attempt.quiz_id);
    const previousAccuracy = previousAttempts.length > 0 ? (previousAttempts[0].score / previousAttempts[0].total * 100) : null;
    const currentAccuracy = (attempt.score / attempt.total * 100);
    
    let improvement = "—";
    if (previousAccuracy !== null) {
      const change = Math.round(currentAccuracy - previousAccuracy);
      improvement = change > 0 ? `↑ +${change}%` : (change < 0 ? `↓ ${change}%` : "→");
    }
    
    html += `
      <tr>
        <td>${attempt.quiz_title}</td>
        <td>${dateStr}</td>
        <td>${attempt.difficulty}</td>
        <td>${attempt.score}/${attempt.total}</td>
        <td>${improvement}</td>
      </tr>
    `;
  });
  
  html += '</tbody></table>';
  document.getElementById("quiz-history").innerHTML = html;
}

function renderAreasToRevisit() {
  const toRevisit = getAreasToRevisit();
  
  if (toRevisit.length === 0) {
    document.getElementById("areas-to-revisit").innerHTML = '<p class="placeholder">*No areas to revisit — keep going!*</p>';
    return;
  }
  
  let html = '<div class="revisit-list">';
  html += '<p class="revisit-intro">Topics with the lowest accuracy or longest time since last attempt:</p>';
  html += '<ul>';
  
  toRevisit.forEach(item => {
    html += `
      <li>
        <strong>${item.topic}</strong>
        <ul>
          <li>Accuracy: ${item.accuracy}%</li>
          <li>Last attempted: ${item.daysSinceLast} days ago</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
    `;
  });
  
  html += '</ul></div>';
  document.getElementById("areas-to-revisit").innerHTML = html;
}
</script>

## Managing Your Progress

### Clear Progress

If you want to start fresh, you can clear all stored progress data:

```html
<button onclick="if(confirm('Clear all progress? This cannot be undone.')) { clearProgress(); location.reload(); }">
  Clear All Progress
</button>
```

Your progress is stored in your browser's local storage. It persists across sessions but is lost if you clear your browser cache.
